scope: KDE Plasma wallpaper API runtime research

runtime.isolation: KWin, Plasma, D-Bus, XDG config/state/cache/runtime under /tmp

checks.name: kwin_startup
checks.evidence: kwin_wayland --virtual created the private kwin-test Wayland socket and stayed alive

checks.name: plasmashell_startup
checks.evidence: plasmashell stayed alive and exported org.kde.plasmashell /PlasmaShell

checks.name: evaluateScript
checks.evidence: org.kde.PlasmaShell.evaluateScript returned successfully for a print probe

checks.name: image_wallpaper_script
checks.evidence: KDE setaswallpaper.desktop ships the same script

checks.name: visible_pixel
checks.evidence: KWin virtual compositor does not advertise wl_shm; grim cannot capture output. KWin ScreenShot2 also rejected the unauthorised lab caller.

decision: Keep KDE wallpaper adapter unsupported. Do not claim G6.9 complete until a compositor path permits a visible-pixel assertion and readback/error behavior is tested.
